title: Day one evening
description: The build from playtest one: the front end, the screen test and the first zombie scene only. Greybox sets, the first zombie, a rough HUD and a rough cut of the replay, and a mannequin for the player.
pending_note: Not playable, so not online. Checked in Chrome on Sunday at 17:30: it downloads (169 MB), starts in 11 seconds with WebGPU on and no errors, and runs at 121 fps, but the screen stays black the whole time. It's listed here because it was our first try.

title: The final build, in your browser
description: Experimental browser version of the final build, with the front end, the screen test and the first zombie scene (Dead Mile Motel). It starts in about 7 seconds once downloaded. The page says 'Click or press a key for sound' until you click, so click once to start. The Windows download is the whole game.
